effects: ChatFilterItem defaults enabled=true. Matching requires enabled and selected PM/MC context; if nick pattern is nonempty it must match and text must either be empty or match. With empty nick pattern, non-empty text alone may match; both empty do not match. Updating matcher changes patterns/methods and prepares both.

IgnoreManager installs private/main-chat incoming hooks. Own messages are not filtered. Ignored sender or reply-to user rejects with user_ignored (except PM users with an existing private chat); configured chat-filter match rejects message_filtered and optionally writes a log when LOG_IGNORED. Rejection is delegated through ActionHookResultGetter.

storeIgnore returns false when User already flagged ignored; otherwise inserts count=0, sets flag, dirty=true, emits IgnoreAdded, updates an existing private chat, notifies ClientManager. removeIgnore returns false if absent; otherwise erases, unsets flag, marks dirty, emits IgnoreRemoved and notifies ClientManager. getIgnoredUsers returns a locked copy; check increments ignored-message count under shared mutex.

Load appends XML ChatFilterItems; save emits their patterns/method/context/enabled attributes and writes IgnoredUsers.xml only from settings save if dirty. Separate Users XML stores CID and IgnoredMessages; load resolves users through ClientManager and reapplies ignored flag. Filter vector direct reference/replaceList are unsynchronized inline APIs; preserve that ownership/threading caveat.
